plainTranslation: Sun conjunction Neptune: 14/ ​© The Dark Pixie Astrology Sun conjunct Neptune, you can be very compassionate, understanding, and feel you have a soul connection with one another, or you can give in to illusion and delusion and not see the reality of the relationship.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
